scenes.head: 廚房裡的小標籤
scenes.say: 廚房裡每一份分裝好的食材，都貼著一張品保標籤。今天帶你看懂它。
scenes.veo: Macro close-up of rows of sealed food containers in a fridge, each with a small white label, camera slowly sliding along.

scenes.head: 第 1 欄：品名
scenes.say: 第一欄是品名，告訴大家這是什麼食材，一眼就能看清楚。
scenes.veo: Close-up of a container of fresh shredded cabbage on a steel counter, a gloved hand pointing at its label.

scenes.head: 第 2 欄：原包裝有效日
scenes.say: 第二欄是原包裝有效日，也就是供應商在原包裝上標示的期限。
scenes.veo: Close-up of an unopened supplier food package, a finger tracing the printed expiry date area, shallow focus.

scenes.head: 第 3 欄：分裝日期
scenes.say: 第三欄是分裝日期。大包裝食材拆開分裝的那一刻，就要記錄下來。
scenes.veo: Gloved hands opening a large food package and portioning it into smaller containers on a sanitized cutting board.

scenes.head: 第 4 欄：櫃位使用期限
scenes.say: 第四欄是櫃位使用期限，代表食材在廚房裡可以使用的最後時間。
scenes.veo: A wall clock in a clean kitchen with a soft focus pull to a labeled container below it.

scenes.head: 鐵則：只能縮短，不能延長
scenes.say: 最重要的鐵則：櫃位使用期限，不能晚於原包裝有效日。分裝、解凍、補印，都不能讓期限變長。
scenes.veo: Dramatic but clean shot of a supervisor in a kitchen reviewing a checklist on a clipboard, firm and focused expression.

scenes.head: 過去：人工手寫
scenes.say: 過去，這些日期靠人工手寫、心算，尖峰時段難免出錯。
scenes.veo: Busy kitchen at peak hour, a staff member hurriedly handwriting on a small label with a marker, slightly hectic atmosphere.

scenes.head: 導入後：系統自動計算
scenes.say: 導入智慧品保標籤後，夥伴只要選擇食材，系統就依主管核准的規則計算日期，自動列印。
scenes.veo: Calm kitchen, a staff member selects an item on a touchscreen and a thermal printer smoothly prints a label, satisfying moment.

scenes.head: 每張標籤都能追溯
scenes.say: 每張標籤都有批次編號，必要時能追查到原本的供應商批次。
scenes.veo: Close-up of a label with a small QR code being scanned by a handheld scanner, soft green light reflection.

scenes.head: 看得懂的標籤
scenes.say: 看得懂的標籤，吃得到的安心。品富餐飲，守護你的每一餐。
scenes.veo: Final hero shot: a neatly labeled food container next to a finished meal box, warm light, camera slowly pulls back.
